final: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t
